notes.title: Exciting News for Onirim
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the game Onirim has recently been updated.
This update brings several fixes and a clean user interface to make your playing experience even more enjoyable.

We would also like to inform you that the game has been acquired by inPatience, the original creator of the Onirim board game. This acquisition paves the way for exciting new features for the game, as well as continued support for our gaming community.

It is important to note that the game is no longer tied to the Asmodee platform. As a result, stats, achievements, leaderboards and DLC are no longer transferable from one platform to another. While this may cause problems for some players, we are working hard to find alternative solutions that will allow players to continue to enjoy all the features of the game.

We remind you that you can still get the "Glyphs" DLC for free by subscribing to our newsletter. This offer is still available to players, and we hope this will encourage you to continue playing our game.

Thank you for your continued support.
The inPatience team.

A problem, need help? Contact us: info@inpatience.com

notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance Operation on January Tuesday 9th 2018
notes.notes:
Please, note that our engineering team will be performing a 2 hours maintenance operation on all our systems on January 9th starting at 4:00 am EST. 
Our online games will be affected. 

More information here https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/asmodee-net/?l=en&s=scheduled-maintenance-operation-on-january-tuesday-9th-2018&f=scheduled-maintenance-operation-on-january-tuesday-9th-2018&p=all
